changelog:
v0.5.3
- Use the documented MediaForge raw-view API for internal calls and late AutoSync registration
- Preserve API-key, scope and source checks with a legacy fallback
- Report safe AutoSync failure reasons and HTTP status without exposing upstream errors
- Add runtime diagnostics and regressions for wrapped handlers, auth failures and retries
description: Searches the movie and TV sources enabled in MediaForge directly from Jellyfin. Users can request downloads; administrators can approve them or enable automatic mode.
name: MediaForge Requests
overview: MediaForge search and download requests for all Jellyfin users
